tool.name: Plot EICs

configfiles.configfile:
import pandas as pd import os import pyarrow.parquet as pq from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor from plotly.subplots import make_subplots import plotly.express as px import plotly.graph_objects as go import pyopenms as oms import numpy as np
marker_filename = '$marker_filename' #set filenames = str("', '").join([str($f.element_identifier) + '.' + str($f.ext) for $f in $files]) #set identifiers = str("', '").join([str($f.element_identifier) for $f in $files]) filenames = ['$filenames'] subplot_titles = ['$identifiers'] template = "$template"
cluster = int(os.getenv('GALAXY_SLOTS', 1))
mz_tol_ppm = $mz_tol_ppm rt_tol_s = $rt_tol_s plots_per_row = $plots_per_row
markers = pd.read_csv(marker_filename, sep='\t')
# color assignment for a large number of variables: def get_colors(var, colorscale): n_colors = var.nunique() colors = px.colors.sample_colorscale(colorscale, [n/(n_colors -1) for n in range(n_colors)]) colordict = {f:colors[i] for i, f in enumerate(var.unique())} return colordict
def load_file(filename: str): ext = os.path.splitext(filename)[1][1:].lower() if ext == 'parquet': eics = pd.read_parquet(filename) elif ext == 'mzml': exp = oms.MSExperiment() oms.MzMLFile().load(filename, exp) eics = exp.get_df(long=True).replace(0, np.nan).dropna(how='any').rename(columns={'RT':'rt', 'inty':'intensity'}) else: raise ValueError(f"Unsupported file extension: {ext}")
eics['Annotation'] = 'Unknown' eics.sort_values(['rt'], inplace=True)
for _, marker in markers.iterrows(): mask = ( (eics['Annotation'] == 'Unknown') & (eics['mz'] >= marker['mz'] - marker['mz'] * mz_tol_ppm * 1e-06) & (eics['mz'] <= marker['mz'] + marker['mz'] * mz_tol_ppm * 1e-06) & (eics['rt'] >= marker['rt'] - rt_tol_s) & (eics['rt'] <= marker['rt'] + rt_tol_s) )
eics.loc[mask, 'Annotation'] = marker['Compound Name'] return eics.drop(eics.loc[eics['Annotation'] == 'Unknown'].index)
colordict = get_colors(markers['Compound Name'], 'phase')
with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=cluster) as executor: samples = executor.map(load_file, filenames)
n_files = len(filenames) n_rows = (n_files + plots_per_row - 1) // plots_per_row
# Pad titles so the list matches the total number of subplot slots.
fig = make_subplots( rows=n_rows, cols=plots_per_row, subplot_titles=subplot_titles, shared_xaxes='all', shared_yaxes='all' )
for i, eics in enumerate(samples): row = i // plots_per_row + 1 col = i % plots_per_row + 1 grouped = eics.groupby('Annotation')
for name, group in grouped: fig.add_trace( go.Scatter( x=group['rt'], y=group['intensity'], mode='lines', name=name, legendgroup=name, line=dict(color=colordict[name]), showlegend=(i == 0) ), row=row, col=col )
fig.update_layout(template=template, xaxis_title="rt", yaxis_title="intensity") fig.write_html('plot.html')
